title.narrative: Country Programme for inclusive and sustainable development of The Gambia 2021-2025

description.narrative: This Country Programme (CP) is designed to enhance UNIDO#s support to the Government of The Gambia to implement a roadmap towards Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID). In doing this, UNIDO has aligned the priorities of its new programme of intervention to The Gambia #Vision 2020# (long-term Vision), the National Development Plan (2018-2021), as well as the United Nations Development Assistance Framework (UNDAF) for the period 2017-2021, building on the achievements of the former country programme and individual projects. Since it is based on established national priorities, the CP will be a practical guide for UNIDO#s interventions in The Gambia over the next 5-year period. The UNIDO Country Programme (CP) for The Gambia will support the implementation of The Gambia National Development Plan 2018-2021, and notably, the Strategic Priorities 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 thereof. More specifically, with the initiatives implemented within the CP framework, UNIDO will contribute to the following key results and targets established by the Plan: # Value chains enhanced for Agriculture and Livestock Transformation - Increase Vegetable production from 34 (000# Mt) to 50 (000# Mt) # Increased production of basic agricultural commodities (crops and livestock) for enhanced food and nutrition security - Increase
